about.title: From first commit to deploy — learning fast along the way.
about.photoAlt: Adriano Nishimoto, back-end and full stack developer
about.p1: I started coding in university and never stopped. Today I'm in my final year of Software Engineering at FIAP, with a technical degree in Systems Development from SENAC Hub Academy and around four years building software in practice.
about.p2: My focus is the back-end: REST APIs, domain modelling and clean architecture. I move comfortably across the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem — React, Node and Next.js — and Python with Django, on top of a solid base in C# and .NET. At Rintek I worked as a Technical Analyst: automating processes with Python, building Power BI dashboards and shipping full-stack features for internal systems.
about.p3: I also bring generative AI into the workflow — I've integrated Google Gemini into a product and use AI agents day to day to ship faster. If one thing defines me, it's how quickly I learn: hand me a new technology and I'll deliver with it on a short deadline.
